assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.description: Manage teaching assignments and additional staff duties.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: Manage subjects, academic-year offerings, and lesson periods.

structure.title: School Structure
structure.description: Manage grade levels, tracks, and school rooms.

years.title: Academic years
years.description: Manage the school's academic years: create, edit, activate, or archive.
years.emptyBody: Create the first academic year to start managing academic data.
years.activateBody: "{label}" will become the active academic year; every other year is deactivated automatically.
years.archiveBody: "{label}" will be archived and no longer shown in the main list.

terms.title: Terms of {year}
terms.empty: No terms for this academic year yet.
terms.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted and cannot be recovered.

gradeLevels.title: Grade levels
gradeLevels.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. It cannot be deleted while a class still references it.
gradeLevels.applyTemplateBody: Creates the standard grade levels for the education level you pick. Codes that already exist are skipped, not duplicated.
gradeLevels.emptyBody: Add grade levels one at a time, or apply a template for the school's education level.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.description: Student majors or tracks, for example Science, Social Studies, or Language in senior high.
tracks.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. It cannot be deleted while a class still references it.
tracks.emptyBody: Add a track if the school offers majors, such as Science or Social Studies.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. It cannot be deleted while a class still references it.
rooms.emptyBody: Add rooms so classes can be assigned to one.

subjectOfferings.title: Subject offerings
subjectOfferings.deleteBody: The offering for "{name}" will be deleted.
subjectOfferings.emptyBody: Add the subjects taught in this academic year.

teachingAssignments.title: Teaching assignments
teachingAssignments.description: Replace a teacher's whole subject and class load for one academic year in a single step.
teachingAssignments.noAssignments: This teacher has no subjects assigned for this academic year yet.
teachingAssignments.confirmBody: {teacher} will teach {n, plural, one {# subject} other {# subjects}}, replacing the previous list.
teachingAssignments.emptyBody: Pick an academic year and a teacher to view and manage their teaching assignments.

enrollmentImport.title: Class assignment import
enrollmentImport.description: Download the template, fill in student class assignments, then upload it to review before anything is applied.
enrollmentImport.moveExisting: Move students who already have a different class this year
enrollmentImport.partial: Apply valid rows even if some rows have errors

newYearSetup.title: New academic year setup
newYearSetup.description: Copy subject offerings and classes from one academic year into another that does not have them yet.
newYearSetup.sameYearError: The source and destination academic years must differ.
newYearSetup.emptyBody: The destination academic year already has every subject offering and class the source year has.
newYearSetup.noOfferings: No subject offerings in the source academic year.
newYearSetup.noClasses: No classes in the source academic year.
newYearSetup.confirmTitle: Copy this data into the destination year?
newYearSetup.confirmBody: {offerings} subject offerings and {classes} classes will be copied.
